External services

This plugin loads a hosted chatbot script to enable messaging functionality. The service is provided by Vitxi Converse and requires an API key from the Vitxi Converse dashboard. When visitors interact with the chatbot, conversation data is transmitted securely to the external service in order to deliver responses. No personal information is stored in WordPress.

  • Purpose: load and display the chatbot interface; handle chat interactions.
  • Data sent: chat messages and technical data required to operate the widget (e.g., IP address).
  • Terms: https://vitxi.ai/terms
  • Privacy: https://vitxi.ai/privacy
sections.installation:
Please follow the following step to step instruction to easily install Vitxi Converse.

  1. Visit Vitxi Converse.click & click on “Get Started FREE” to embark on the Chatbot Building journey.
  2. If you are not an existing Vitxi Converse user, Click here to register.

– To get your unique key, follow these steps:
– Go to the Dashboard
– Click Create Bot
– Select a use case, e.g., E-Commerce
– Choose a platform, e.g., Web Platform
– Click Install on the top right corner
– Select WordPress
– Copy the generated unique key and paste it below

From Dashboard ( WordPress admin )

  • Plugins > Add New
  • Search for Vitxi Converse
  • Click on Install Now and then Activate.

using FTP or similar

  • Unzip downloaded “Vitxi Converse” file and
  • Upload Vitxi Converse folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  • Activate the plugin via the “Plugins” menu in WordPress Admin.
sections.faq:
Here are the few very frequently asked questions and their answers as
follows:

What is Vitxi Converse?

Vitxi Converse is a powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to integrate an AI-powered chatbot directly onto your website. It helps you automate customer support, engage visitors, and capture leads 24/7 without any coding required.

Can you use ChatGPT with WordPress?

Absolutely! Vitxi Converse’s ChatGPT-integrated chatbot is designed for WordPress, allowing you to enhance user engagement and automate interactions on your website 24/7. You can integrate the ChatGPT model of your choice and train the GPT bot on your data to fit your specific use case.

Is Vitxi Converse difficult to set up?

Not at all. The setup process is designed to be user-friendly. After activating the plugin, you will be guided through a simple configuration process to connect your Vitxi Converse account and get the chatbot running on your site in minutes.

How do I see the conversations and leads collected by the chatbot?

All conversations and data collected by the chatbot are stored in your Vitxi Converse dashboard. You can log in to your account to view chat history, access lead information, and analyze the chatbot’s performance.

Do you offer a free way to get started?

Yes, Vitxi Converse offers a free plan to get you started. You can craft your chatbot, install the plugin, and get it running on your site without any initial cost .

What are some of the things I can do with Vitxi Converse bot?

You can use the bot for a vast range of tasks, including:
Customer Support & Answering FAQs
Lead Generation (Email, Newsletters)
Appointment Setting & Scheduling
E-commerce and Payment Processing
Database Management
Managing To-do Lists and Reminders
Conducting Surveys
And many more business functions.

Are there any ready-to-use templates available?

Yes, Vitxi Converse comes with a wide variety of pre-built templates for numerous industries to help you get started quickly. These include templates for:
Real Estate & Legal Services
Travel, Hotel & Restaurant Booking
Healthcare (Dental Clinics, Doctor Appointments)
E-commerce & Product Catalogs
Education (Universities, Coaching)
Digital Marketing & HR Consultancies
And many more.

Does Vitxi Converse integrate with WhatsApp?

While it is not a dedicated WhatsApp plugin, Vitxi Converse seamlessly integrates with WhatsApp. This allows you to create a comprehensive WhatsApp chatbot experience, including marketing automation, drip & broadcast campaigns, notifications, and bookings.

In what languages can the chatbot communicate?

Vitxi Converse supports multiple languages. You can configure the chatbot to interact with your website visitors in the language of your choice to provide a more personalized experience.

Can I take over a conversation from the chatbot?

Yes, most configurations allow for a “live chat” takeover feature. If a visitor needs to speak with a human agent, the chatbot can notify you, and you can jump into the conversation directly from your Vitxi Converse dashboard.

What are other Chatbot building platforms?

There are many other chatbot platforms like WP-Chatbot for Messenger, Chatbot for WordPress, chatbot with IBM Watson, chatbot for WooCommerce, Collect.chat, Hubspot, Conversational forms for a chatbot, Tidio live chat, Gobot, clients chatbot, Cliengo, Acobot AI chatbot, Chatbot Botnation plugin, my chatbot, Live chat with slack for WordPress, ArtiBot free chatbot for WordPress websites, Chatbot for messenger, Gist, Botsify, Instabot, Smart bot, Pandorabots, RASA, Dialogflow, Chatterton, Mobile Monkey, Chatfuel, ChatMate, SnatchBot, Flow XO, Manychat & many more.
Start creating your own chatbot Now: Vitxi Converse

External services

This plugin loads a hosted chatbot script to enable messaging functionality. The service is provided by Vitxi Converse and requires an API key from the Vitxi Converse dashboard. When visitors interact with the chatbot, conversation data is transmitted securely to the external service in order to deliver responses. No personal information is stored in WordPress.
